"""Keep all four endpoints visible beside each retained useful implementation."""
from pathlib import Path

from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save

repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V168-fine-mesh-ladder-v3'
current=read(root/'scores-v1.json');cases=read(root/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']
sources={
    'V156':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261103/V157-spatial-rgb-v1','local-control'),
    'V157':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261103/V157-spatial-rgb-v1','spatial-rgb'),
    'V158':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V158-regional-dc-v1','dc-regret'),
    'V159':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V159-regional-dc-transition-v1','smooth-dc'),
    'V160 ordinary':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1','ordinary'),
    'V160 paired':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V160-paired-response-v1','paired-response'),
    'V161':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V161-harmonic-context-v1','harmonic-context'),
    'V162':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V162-flat-target-anchor-v1','flat-anchor'),
    'V163':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V163-harmonic-phase-v1','harmonic-phase'),
    'V164':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V164-pair-unit-floor-v1','fine-pair'),
    'V165':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V165-pair-common-v1','pair-common'),
    'V166':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V166-common-support-routing-v2','routed-common'),
    'V167':(repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V167-bounded-support-v1','bounded-support'),
}
now={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in current['rows']}
methods=[f'{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000' for arm in ['legacy-control','fine-mesh'] for endpoint in ['raw','EMA']]
specifications=[]
for prior in ['iso6400-prior','iso12800-prior']:
    specifications.append(('mixed-quiet',prior,None,['quiet_error_RMS_DN16','quiet_spatial_RMS_DN16','crop_DC_RMS_DN16'],16))
    specifications.append(('flat',prior,'fresh-flat512',['full_error_RMS_DN16','block32_RMS_DN16'],24))
for cohort in ['retained512','organic384']:
    for variant in ['photo-faint','photo-dark']:
        specifications.append(('photo',variant,cohort,['full_error_RMS_DN16','crop_relative_band_error'],32))
groups=[];summary=[];bindings={}
for version,(path,arm) in sources.items():
    prior=read(path/'scores-v1.json');bindings[version]=ref(path/'scores-v1.json')
    oldcases=read(path/'quality-design-v1.json')['observations']
    assert len(cases)==len(oldcases)==822
    assert all(a['id']==b['id'] and a['arrays']==b['arrays'] and a['parent']==b['parent'] for a,b in zip(cases,oldcases,strict=True))
    old={(r['id'],r['method']):r for r in prior['rows']}
    for c in cases:assert now[c['id'],'parent']==old[c['id'],'parent']
    for method in methods:
        for endpoint in ['raw','EMA']:
            baseline=f'{arm}-{endpoint}-step1000'
            for kind,condition,cohort,fields,count in specifications:
                selected=[c for c in cases if c['kind']==kind and c.get('cohort')==cohort and
                    (c['variant']['name'] if kind=='photo' else c['noise']['name'])==condition]
                assert len(selected)==count
                for field in fields:
                    pairs=[{'id':c['id'],'candidate':now[c['id'],method][field],'baseline':old[c['id'],baseline][field],
                        'difference':now[c['id'],method][field]-old[c['id'],baseline][field]} for c in selected]
                    delta=[p['difference'] for p in pairs]
                    groups.append({'retained_version':version,'method':method,'baseline':baseline,
                        'kind':kind,'condition':condition,'cohort':cohort,'field':field,'cases':count,'pairs':pairs,
                        'better':sum(v<0 for v in delta),'worse':sum(v>0 for v in delta),'equal':sum(v==0 for v in delta),
                        'maximum_increase':max(delta),'maximum_decrease':min(delta)})
            for entry in current['summary']:
                if entry['method']!=method or entry['kind']=='real':continue
                key=entry['kind'],entry['condition'],entry['cohort']
                before=next(v for v in prior['summary'] if (v['kind'],v['condition'],v['cohort'])==key and v['method']==baseline)
                for field in ['template_gain','blank_error_RMS_DN16','quiet_error_RMS_DN16','crop_DC_RMS_DN16',
                    'full_error_RMS_DN16','block32_RMS_DN16','crop_relative_band_error','crop_linear_sRGB_luma_band_gain']:
                    if field not in entry or field not in before:continue
                    a,b=entry[field],before[field]
                    summary.append({'retained_version':version,'method':method,'baseline':baseline,
                        'kind':key[0],'condition':key[1],'cohort':key[2],'field':field,
                        'candidate':a,'baseline_value':b,'percent_change':100*(a/b-1) if b else None})
output=root/'retained-comparisons-v1.json';assert not output.exists()
save(output,{'status':'completed-all-fixed-endpoint-retained-comparisons','scores':ref(root/'scores-v1.json'),
    'retained_scores':bindings,'same822_input_parent_bindings':True,'same_parent_metric_rows':True,
    'groups':groups,'summary':summary,'paired_error_entries':sum(g['cases'] for g in groups),
    'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
    'scope':'Two identical V167 bounded-support heads,124909 parameters/47 tensors,support floor.25,all90 neural source files unchanged. Only candidate data distribution differs:171/341 mesh batches replace periods6..32 with6..10 and balanced contrast bands.02,.05,.125,.25,.4;829 original batches/parents unchanged. Camera/CFA/geometry/background/exposure/noise coefficients/seeds match;changed Poisson rates do not imply identical noisy draws. New clean empty targets exactly match legacy. Same V167 common fixed-support surrogate routing/weight1/unit16,difference1/floor2/epsilon.003,anchor.25,base losses/init/AdamW/LR/clipping/EMA. 1000updates each,fixed raw/EMA endpoints/all822 cases,3288 review roots/1644 new external arrays and1644 actual bit-exact V167 control replays. No architecture,loss or held-out input changes;frequency and contrast change jointly,not isolated factors. New data cache has171 original parent/DINO roots plus171 explicit archived-deterministic-policy validation roots;684images each pass,342root/1368images total per parent/backbone. All inputs/noise constructed once;6 inspected inputs adopted and165additional inputs. Head stages have20 discarded smoke+2000 train+3288 review=5308roots/11368images,with no new compatibility roots becauseall90 neural sources match. 288 CPU checks;genuine8+2 restoration;94 final Adam states;all1000 V167 control trace/raw/EMA/Adam and1644 actual outputs must reproduce. Actual units and masks need audits for171 new target batches;829 inherited masks replay separately. Both GFX scenes/priors/windows/JPEGs and18held-out IDs stay excluded;references qualitative,notGT.72native figures/24triplets/actual viewing/eight retained comparators. New56/116GiB reserves+.5GiB margin,.25GiB local bound;12GiB CUDA,52/32GiB RAM. Originals/dataz unused;prior sources,receipts,first data-cache flag omission and all predictions preserved. No quality or flat-safety guarantee.'})
print('Retained comparisons:',len(groups),'groups,',sum(g['cases'] for g in groups),'paired error entries;',len(summary),'mean cells')
